svg.aria-label: Gangadhara Gooti, full-stack engineer for web, mobile, desktop and AI. Building software that feels simple on the surface, engineered deeply underneath. A stack of five glass layers opens up, and each layer slides out in turn: interface, devices, services, data and intelligence.
